title: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Terms — Deposit on a Made-to-Order Remake
content:
**Clause.** The deposit on a remake of a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order pair is the remake's reserved unit price times its units times the remake deposit percentage, divided by 100. The remake deposit percentage is the deposit percentage of the Made-to-Order Reservation type, which is the standard remake deposit percentage. The remake deposit is never less than the type's minimum deposit, and that floor applies last. The deposit is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. It is charged to the card at reservation.

**Quantities**

| Quantity | What it is |
|---|---|
| Reserved unit price | That of the remake, which is reserved at the reserved unit price of the cancelled pair |
| Units | Those of the remake: one |
| Remake deposit percentage | The deposit percentage of the Made-to-Order Reservation type |
| Floor | The minimum deposit of the Made-to-Order Reservation type |

**Order of working.** The price, meaning the unit price times the units, is multiplied by the remake deposit percentage and divided by 100. The floor is then applied, so the deposit is the higher of that amount and the minimum deposit. Rounding half up to the cent comes once, after the floor.

**Worked examples.** These use hypothetical remakes. The Made-to-Order Reservation type figures used are 50 percent, with a $50.00 minimum.

| Remake reserved unit price | Price times 50, divided by 100 | Higher of that and $50.00 | Deposit charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| $380.00 | $190.00 | $190.00 | $190.00 |
| $84.99 | $42.495 | $50.00 | $50.00 |
| $261.25 | $130.625 | $130.625 | $130.63 |
